ForWhat it covers
Business workflows and technologySmall to medium businessesEmail, spreadsheets, POS, booking, and accounting connected, with the repetitive steps automated, so nobody retypes orders at the end of the day.
Cloud and AI engineeringTechnical teamsInfrastructure as code, deploy pipelines with checks and rollback, AI assistants that answer from your own documents, and backups proven by test restores.
Networks, devices, and spacesOffices, homes, and physical spacesWi-Fi that reaches the rooms you use, cameras that record and alert as set, devices configured and documented, and smart gear on its own network.
Security awareness and readinessOrganizations, teams, families, and individualsPlain-language sessions on phishing, fraud, passwords, and data brokers, plus SOC 2 readiness for companies heading into an audit.
